This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations.
